free_tier.stated: The service is closed: WeVPN is shutting down, the company confirmed in a short statement published on its website, and users with active subscriptions can migrate to Windscribe.

egress.terms: Not applicable: the provider stopped serving in April 2023.; ingress: none

limits.value: the service is closed, so every constraint is moot

binding_note: A dead provider has no binding constraint; the record exists so the name is not researched again.

identity_cost.detail: Not applicable; existing subscriptions were migrated to Windscribe at no charge for the remaining term.

confidence_note: Third-party report dated 2023-04-14. wevpn.com itself returned HTTP 530 on the single attempt made, so the vendor's own shutdown notice was not read. The confirmation would be an archive capture of wevpn.com from mid-2023.

evidence.proved: Published 2023-04-14: WeVPN shut down citing unforeseen financial difficulties and migrated active subscriptions to Windscribe; Windscribe did not acquire the company.
Nothing: the attempt returned HTTP 530, which establishes nothing about the target.

notes: The successor question in the brief is answered by the migration rather than by a rebrand: there is no WeVPN successor product, and the users went to a different company's paid tier. Any future session looking for WeVPN capacity should look at Windscribe's Pro port forwarding instead.

extras.wg_detail: The service no longer operates, so no config can be obtained. Successor for existing users is Windscribe, which forwards ports only on its paid Pro plan.
extras.volume_stated: Not applicable: the provider stopped serving in April 2023.
